stories.title: Shooting struggles bring 'mixed feelings' as Utah Jazz fall at home
stories.summary: The Utah Jazz's losing streak at home was extended by the Phoenix Suns on Friday, and the loss hurt a little more considering the opposite result was well within reach.

stories.title: Box Elder County sheriff charged with automobile homicide for deadly crash
stories.summary: Box Elder County Sheriff Kevin Potter is facing criminal charges for his involvement in a crash that led to the death of a 22-year-old motorcyclist.

stories.title: Spanish Fork community rallies around 25-year-old man injured in hit-and-run
stories.summary: Culver's in Spanish Fork will host a fundraiser on Nov. 30 to help support 25-year-old Alan Zelaya after he suffered serious injuries in an alleged hit-and-run.

stories.title: Serious crash closes US-6 near Soldier Summit
stories.summary: A crash involving a semitruck closed both directions of U.S. Highway 6 near Soldier Summit on Friday night, causing serious injuries and shutting down traffic for several hours, according to the Utah Highway Patrol.

stories.title: Woman accused of picking up man, then hitting his wife with SUV
stories.summary: An Emery County woman was charged with attempted murder and accused of purposely hitting a woman with her vehicle after picking up her husband.

stories.title: Downtown Salt Lake candy windows just about ready
stories.summary: The cold temperatures and the rumblings of winter mean that the popular Macy's Candy Windows in downtown Salt Lake City are just around the corner.

stories.title: Aerial reseeding operations taking place on Cottonwood Fire burn scar
stories.summary: The Cottonwood Fire left behind large areas of scorched vegetation. Now, state agencies and aerial crews are working to help the mountain recover through a massive reseeding operation.

stories.title: F-35A Lightning II Demonstration Team to leave Hill Air Force Base by 2027
stories.summary: The F-35A Lightning II Demonstration Team will be leaving Hill Air Force Base after seven years, returning to their home at Luke Air Force Base in Arizona.

stories.title: Review: 'I Play Rocky' might be even more inspiring than original 'Rocky'
stories.summary: tAfter seeing "I Play Rocky" I'm starting to think the story behind "Rocky" might be even more inspiring than the original "Rocky."

stories.title: Nevada man charged in fatal shooting in Granary district
stories.summary: A Nevada man was charged with murder on Friday for allegedly shooting a driver in Salt Lake City in what prosecutors describe as a 'random' incident.

stories.title: A reading program tied to the Olympic Games is impacting Utah classrooms
stories.summary: Students in 72 classrooms across Utah have taken up an Olympic challenge to read more, and it's working.

stories.title: Body found in California search is missing Utah Marine, father confirms
stories.summary: A body found Friday in Twentynine Palms, California, during an extensive search for a missing Utah Marine has been identified by his father as 19-year-old Marriner Richards.
